name: Week 33 Optional KB — Overhead Mobility Complex
description: Optional and deliberately short. The overhead mobility complex carries the day, light and slow: row, swing snatch, overhead lunge, overhead squat and push press on one side before switching. A single easy curl round closes it. Two rounds per side when fresh; one is a complete session.

dayOverview.theme: One light overhead mobility complex carries the day, followed by an optional easy curl dose. Rounds are the variable, never the bell.

spotlights.why: The overhead squat sets the bell for the whole complex. If the arm cannot stay stacked overhead at depth, the bell is too heavy.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: The outside snatch flow rotates in next.
watchpoints: 🛑 keep it shy — the cue is the cap: swing snatch, overhead lunge, overhead squat, push press. Overhead and ballistic work where the cue breaking is the ceiling.
**Light bell — 20-25.** This is mobility, not conditioning.
**All reps on one side before switching, no rest between exercises, 60s between rounds.**
**If the overhead squat will not hold at depth, reduce the depth, not the standard of the lockout.**
**KB curl: left arm first, stop short of straight, no near-failure.**
**Banded shoulder prep + protective shrug stay in the warm-up**, even on the twenty-minute version.

sets.name: Warm-Up — Halos + Bottoms-Up Cuff Prep + Cossacks
sets.notes: Light bell throughout. The bottoms-up work is cuff prep, and the complex is about to ask for a lot of overhead lockouts.

exercises.notes: Light bell, smooth hand-to-hand passes with the torso quiet.
Light bell inverted. Cuff prep and grip, and it rehearses the packed-down lockout. **If the left will not hold the bell quiet and stacked, go lighter for the whole session.**
**Your readiness screen.** Deep as the hips allow, heel down. Read it against your own normal.
Hinged slightly forward, tight fists, thumbs tucked.
Protective activation. Down and back at the top.

sets.name: Banded Shoulder Prep (~2 min)
sets.notes:
One round of all seven, about two minutes. Sustained tension, no rest between positions. **This is the KB-day shoulder anchor and it does not come out.**

**Tired-day version:** 6 reps each. Exhausted: do it anyway at whatever range is smooth.

exercises.notes: Arms overhead, pull apart without letting the ribs flare.
Slow and controlled. Blades down and together.
Thumbs up, arms to a T. Traps stay quiet.
Rear delts. Lead with the elbows.
Hold the V overhead. Ribs down, shoulders packed.

sets.name: 🌀 Overhead Mobility Complex — Light and Slow
sets.notes:
**Light bell — 20-25. This is mobility, not conditioning.** Two rounds each side, slow, 60s between rounds.

🛑 The overhead squat sets the bell for the whole complex — if the arm cannot stay stacked overhead at depth, the bell is too heavy.

sets.name: Left-Arm Curl Dose 🛑
sets.notes: One round, and the only loaded arm work here. This stays because the left arm wants **frequency**, not intensity.

exercises.notes:
**LOAD: light bell, ~25-35. LEFT ARM FIRST — match the right to it.**
- **Upper arm pinned to the ribs**, elbow does not drift forward
- **Stop short of a fully straight arm at the bottom** — the bell loads that end position harder than a dumbbell does, and that end position is what the left tendon dislikes
- Shoulder packed down, no shrug to start

**No near-failure.** Calm load, full control.

sets.name: Cooldown (Shoulder + Hip + QL Release)
sets.notes:
Overhead-heavy day — the shoulders come first.

**Tired-day version:** 30s each.

exercises.notes: 30s each arm, elbow at MID height.
Passive. Let the shoulders decompress after all that lockout work.
Adductors — the overhead lunges earned this.
30s each side. Let the QL downshift.

tips: Rounds are the variable, never the bell.
Light bell, 20-25: this is mobility, not conditioning.
The overhead squat is the hard part; reduce depth before reducing the lockout standard.
KB curl: left first, stop short of straight, no near-failure.
Missing this day entirely does not make the week incomplete.
